burst: Normal attacks deal True Damage for 10 sec.

caveats: ⚑ Acid Ammo DoT: kit gives no stack/refresh rule. Modeled as ONE maintained instance (192% of final ATK every 1 s, duration >= fight). A literal per-magazine re-application of a 30 s DoT would stack ~10 concurrent instances (~1920%/s) because the engine appends DoT instances without dedup — globally implausible against her normal-attack DPS, so the maintained reading is the working hypothesis, not a measurement.
⚑ Acid Ammo DoT crit: left OFF (engine default; DoT crit is opt-in only where measured). noFb also left unset, so ticks take the +50% Full Burst major by landing timing (schema default).

⚑ Cadence tuple: pulls/s is datamine-unreliable and ammo 9 / reloadFrames 81 set how often Magnum Ammo and (under the literal reading) Acid Ammo re-apply. Magazine cycle length is the single biggest lever on both.
⚑ Hit Rate ▲ 80.78%: magnitude is kit-stated, but the hit-rate -> core-hit lift is the engine's derived hrCoreMult — the resulting core-rate change during her 10 s burst window is UNMEASURED.

Magnum Ammo is authored as 9 ROUNDS (durationShots), not seconds. At base capacity 9 the battle-start application plus the reload re-application tile every magazine, so uptime is 100% and the model is numerically identical to a permanent normalAttackPct 30. It diverges (correctly) only if max ammo is raised above 9, where rounds 10+ are unbuffed. Both blocks grant the same stat from the same caster slot, so same-caster-slot overwrite prevents any double-count.

The reload re-applications are keyed to `lastBullet` (fires at reload START) because the schema has no reload-COMPLETE trigger. No shot fires between reload start and reload completion and the buff is round-counted, so the phase offset moves no damage; the DoT phase would shift by one reload if the literal per-magazine reading is ever adopted.

Burst reload line is a stat CLAMP ('fixed at a 99.96% increase'), which the schema cannot express; approximated as an additive reloadSpeedPct 99.96 for 10 s. Identical while nothing else buffs Jill's reload, OVER-credits if a teammate stacks reload speed on top (a clamp would cap it).

'Normal attacks deal True Damage for 10 sec' is UNMODELED: the schema carries trueNormals only on weaponSwap and Jill swaps no weapon. Consequence: during her burst window her normals are not true-flavored, so S1's True Damage ▲ 34.99% has nothing to boost and the DEF-ignoring behaviour of true damage is absent — her burst window is under-credited. This is a schema/engine gap, not a modeling choice.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Jill (jill) is AR/Electric/Attacker/Burst III, ammo 9, no weapon swap, no direct burst damage — her burst is pure self-buff plus an ammo dump. S1 Magnum Ammo is normalAttackPct 30 held for 9 ROUNDS (durationShots, never wall-clock), applied at battle start and re-applied on every reload-to-max; at base capacity the two applications tile the magazine, giving 100% uptime. S1's True Damage ▲ 34.99% is keyed to burstCast ('when using Burst Skill'), so it fires only on rotations Jill herself bursts, never on a teammate-completed Full Burst. S2 Acid Ammo is one maintained sustained-flavor DoT of 192% of final ATK every 1 s covering the fight, rather than one 30 s instance per magazine; S2's ATK ▲ 40.03% is fullBurstEnter and therefore fires on any team Full Burst. In the burst block the buffs are ordered before consumeAmmo so the forced reload runs at the boosted reload speed; consumeAmmo fraction 1 supplies both 'Removes 100% of ammo' and 'Forced Reload', and its forced reload re-fires the lastBullet-keyed Magnum Ammo application. Hit Rate ▲ 80.78% feeds the engine's derived hit-rate-to-core lift. The one kit line with no schema home is 'Normal attacks deal True Damage', recorded verbatim in unmodeled.

flags.field: override.skill2[0].effects[0] (Acid Ammo DoT — application model / durationSec)
flags.estimate: ONE maintained instance: atkPct 192, intervalSec 1, durationSec 180 (>= fight length)
flags.reasoning: Kit states a per-reload application of a 30 s DoT but gives no stack/refresh rule — outside the input domain. The engine appends DoT instances and never dedups, so a literal per-magazine re-application over a ~3 s magazine cycle would hold ~10 concurrent instances (~1920%/s of final ATK), which fails the whole-picture check against her normal-attack output (71.09% per round at AR cadence). The maintained-instance reading matches the documented 'continuous/maintained DoT = ONE passive instance' prior.
flags.recipe: In footage, isolate a mid-fight 5 s window and count sustained-damage popups per second and their VALUES: exactly 1 popup/s at a flat value = one maintained instance (as modeled); N simultaneous popups/s or a value that climbs magazine-by-magazine = stacking (switch to a `lastBullet` trigger with durationSec 30 and re-run the board). A single reading is HYPOTHESIS-strength — record n>=5.

flags.estimate: Kit magnitude 80.78 used as-is; resulting core-rate change is whatever the engine's hrCoreMult yields
flags.reasoning: Hit-Rate -> core magnitude is an ALWAYS-⚑ field: measured-only. The kit percentage is ground truth, the CONVERSION to core-hit frequency is a derived engine constant, so her burst-window core share is unvalidated for this unit.
flags.recipe: Count CORE HIT popups vs plain popups across her 10 s burst window and across an equal-length non-burst window in the same fight; the ratio of core fractions is the empirical lift for an 80.78% hit-rate grant. Compare with the engine's hrCoreMult prediction (HRCORE=0 to disable as the control). Needs n>=5 windows.

flags.estimate: Datamined values used unchanged; magazine cycle assumed ~9 rounds + 81-frame reload
flags.reasoning: rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and for Jill they are load-bearing twice over: the magazine cycle sets the Magnum Ammo re-application rate AND (under the literal Acid Ammo reading) the DoT stacking rate. An error here scales two mechanics at once, not just shot count.
flags.recipe: Frame-count one full magazine from footage: first-shot frame to ninth-shot frame gives effective pulls/s (remember effective = 60/ceil(60/nominal)); ninth-shot frame to next-first-shot frame gives true reload frames. Repeat inside and outside her burst to also validate the reload-speed line.

flags.reasoning: The kit says reload speed is FIXED at a 99.96% increase — a stat clamp, a primitive the schema does not have. Additive modeling is exact in isolation but will exceed the fixed value if any teammate or cube grants reload speed, silently adding shots during her burst.
flags.recipe: Frame-count her forced reload during burst in a comp with NO other reload-speed source, then in a comp WITH one. If both reloads take the same number of frames, the line is a true clamp and the additive model over-credits in the buffed comp; record the delta before landing any team that stacks reload speed.

flags.field: override.unmodeled.burst[0] ('Normal attacks deal True Damage for 10 sec')
flags.estimate: Not modeled — zero effect in the sim
flags.reasoning: Schema gap, not a judgement call: true-flavored normals exist only via weaponSwap.trueNormals and Jill has no swap. Two consequences, both under-crediting her: her normals keep the DEF-subject path during burst, and S1's True Damage ▲ 34.99% has no true-flavored normal attacks to boost, making that whole buff nearly inert.
flags.recipe: Compare her per-shot popup value inside the burst window against the DEF-subject prediction for the same buff state; a systematic step above prediction that matches boss-DEF removal confirms the mechanic. Enacting it requires a new engine primitive (a scoped true-flavor tag on normals, independent of weaponSwap) — that is an engine change and belongs in a separate gated pass, not this baseline.

flags.estimate: durationShots 9, tiling a 9-round magazine at 100% uptime
flags.reasoning: 'for 9 round(s)' is a ROUND count that spans reloads, not seconds. It happens to equal her base capacity, so the model is indistinguishable from a permanent buff at scope-lock gear — the round semantics only become observable if max ammo is ever raised above 9 (cube/OL/ally ammo grant), where rounds 10+ must be unbuffed.
flags.recipe: Run a comp with an ammo-capacity grant and compare per-shot popup values on rounds 1-9 vs 10+; a step DOWN after round 9 confirms the round-count semantics. No further work needed under the scope-lock preset.

flags.estimate: noFb unset (DoT ticks take +50% Full Burst by landing timing); crit unset (ticks do not crit)
flags.reasoning: Both are ALWAYS-⚑ measured-only fields with documented defaults — FB-by-timing ON, DoT crit OFF unless measured for the specific unit. Setting either blind would be fabrication.
flags.recipe: Read Acid Ammo tick popups straddling a Full Burst boundary: a ~1.5x step at FB start confirms noFb should stay unset. Separately, scan tick popups for orange/crit styling across a long window; any crit-styled sustained ticks would justify crit: true (record the observed fraction, n>=5 fights).
